internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Since 1973, Global Manufacturing, Inc.® has manufactured industrial vibrators, concrete vibrators, and air cannons (also known as air blasters). In 2002 we purchased the Viber® Company, a manufacturer of internal concrete vibrators, and moved it to Global’s factory at 1801 East 22nd Street, in Little Rock, Arkansas, USA.
